tasks.subject: Explore project context for admin console DC API support
tasks.description: Read existing admin console code and the recent deeplink design spec to understand current architecture before brainstorming DC API support.

tasks.subject: Ask clarifying questions about DC API feature
tasks.description: One question at a time: which flows (issuance/presentation), which platforms/browsers, fallback behavior, how selection is presented in admin console UI.

tasks.subject: Propose approaches for DC API support
tasks.description: Present 2-3 approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation.

tasks.subject: Present design and get approval
tasks.description: Present design in scaled sections, get user approval per section.

tasks.subject: Write design doc and self-review
tasks.description: Save to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-03-admin-console-dc-api-design.md, commit, self-review for placeholders/consistency/scope/ambiguity.

tasks.subject: User review of spec, then hand off to writing-plans
tasks.description: Ask user to review spec file, incorporate changes, then invoke writing-plans skill.
